newsitem.title: CANADA: CT Financial has no comment on CIBC rumor.
newsitem.headline: CT Financial has no comment on CIBC rumor.

text.p: CT Financial Services Inc said on Friday that it had no immediate comment on a trading halt imposed on its stock today by the Toronto Stock Exchange after a published report that Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce was in talks to acquire CT's Canada Trust.
"My official word on this is we don't comment on rumors and speculation. And this is nothing but rumors and speculation," said Mark Towhey, spokesman at Canada Trust, Canada's biggest trust company.
Toronto's Financial Post reported on Friday that CIBC was in "top secret talks" to acquire Canada Trust.
The acquisition would make CIBC Canada's largest bank, passing Royal Bank of Canada.
CIBC spokesman Paul Howard said the bank would not comment on the report.
CT shares were halted ahead of a statement from the company. The company said it was deciding what to say in the statement requested by the exchange.
CT is majority owned by Imasco Ltd. Imasco shares rose 1.20 to 42.85 in Toronto.
